```{r include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(SummarizedExperiment)
library(imcRtools)
library(patchwork)
```

```{r}
# ---- config ----
pt <- params$patient_id

if (grepl("^\\d+$", pt)) {
  steinbock_dir <- paste0("/restricted/projectnb/camplab/projects/20220504_Suzuki_LN/TumorIMC/steinbock/p",
                          pt, "_results/")
} else {
  steinbock_dir <- paste0("/restricted/projectnb/camplab/projects/20220504_Suzuki_LN/TumorIMC/steinbock/",
                          pt, "/")
}

coord_cols <- c("Start_push", "End_push", "Pushes_duration", "X", "Y", "Z")

markers_of_interest <- c(
  "SMA", "CD4", "CD8a", "CD19", "CD15", "CD14", "CD86", "LAMP3",
  "Ki67", "CD138", "PD1", "PDL1", "FoxP3", "CD68", "CD163", "TIM3",
  "CD141", "CD11c", "CD56", "CD117", "EpCAM", "CD38", "CD45RO",
  "MKI67", "LAG3", "CD1c"
)
```

```{r}
# ---- load_spe ----
spe <- read_steinbock(steinbock_dir)
```

```{r}
# ---- build_channel_map ----
filtered_dir <- file.path(steinbock_dir, "filtered/")
raw_files    <- list.files(filtered_dir, pattern = "\\.txt$", full.names = TRUE)

txt_cols      <- names(read_tsv(raw_files[1], show_col_types = FALSE))
marker_cols   <- txt_cols[!txt_cols %in% coord_cols]
txt_to_marker <- setNames(
  str_extract(marker_cols, "^[^(]+"),
  marker_cols
)
```

```{r}
# ---- load_pre_seg ----
set.seed(42)
pre_seg <- map_dfr(raw_files, function(f) {
  df  <- read_tsv(f, show_col_types = FALSE)
  roi <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(f))

  df <- df[sample(nrow(df), min(50000, nrow(df))), ]

  df |>
    pivot_longer(cols = -any_of(coord_cols),
                 names_to = "channel", values_to = "intensity") |>
    mutate(
      channel = recode(channel, !!!txt_to_marker),
      channel = if_else(channel == "TTF1orCD16", "TTForCD16", channel),
      roi     = roi,
      source  = "raw_pixel"
    )
}) |>
  filter(channel %in% rownames(spe))
```

```{r}
# ---- load_post_seg ----
post_counts <- assay(spe, "counts") |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  rownames_to_column("channel") |>
  pivot_longer(-channel, names_to = "cell_id", values_to = "intensity") |>
  mutate(
    roi    = str_remove(cell_id, "_\\d+$"),
    source = "post_seg_0to100"
  )

post_asinh <- post_counts |>
  mutate(
    intensity = asinh(intensity / 1),
    source    = "post_seg_asinh"
  )
```

```{r}
# ---- combine ----
combined <- bind_rows(pre_seg, post_counts, post_asinh) |>
  filter(channel %in% rownames(spe))

markers_present <- intersect(markers_of_interest, rownames(spe))
combined        <- combined |> filter(channel %in% markers_present)
```

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=4}
# ---- plot_distributions ----
source_colors <- c(
  "raw_pixel"       = "#4E79A7",
  "post_seg_0to100" = "#F28E2B",
  "post_seg_asinh"  = "#59A14F"
)
source_labels <- c(
  "raw_pixel"       = "Raw pixel",
  "post_seg_0to100" = "Post-seg (0-100)",
  "post_seg_asinh"  = "Post-seg asinh"
)

combined <- combined |>
  mutate(source = factor(source, levels = c("raw_pixel", "post_seg_0to100", "post_seg_asinh")))

for (m in markers_present) {
  plot_df <- combined |> filter(channel == m)

  p <- ggplot(plot_df,
              aes(x = intensity, fill = source, color = source)) +
    geom_density(alpha = 0.35, linewidth = 0.6) +
    facet_wrap(~ source, scales = "free", nrow = 1,
               labeller = labeller(source = source_labels)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values  = source_colors) +
    scale_color_manual(values = source_colors) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Patient ", pt, "  |  ", m),
      x     = "Intensity",
      y     = "Density"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "none")

  print(p)
}
```
